halt_reason: §20 Check 4 INVALID — No False Dashboard (§13.5): all 36 matched_leads are enrichment-only with no PRIMARY_EVENT_SOURCE.

items.item: 4 of 6 declared sources have no built adapter and no raw data — clerk_recordings, district_court, sheriff_tax_auctions, tax_collector. All 4 require browser + reCAPTCHA infrastructure not present in this environment (ESC-002). Without any PRIMARY_EVENT_SOURCE raw data the build cannot ship a dashboard.

gis_parcels source has no adapter/raw data. Phase 2 enrichment discovery used the smithcountymapsite.org TaxParcels ArcGIS layer via the parcel_master adapter; gis_parcels remains a config entry with no adapter.

scrapers/parcel_master.py emits the §4.32 wrapped raw-record shape (v5.1.2). v5.4.0 raw_event_record.schema.json requires top-level raw_event_id / source_role / canonical_doc_type / parties / property_refs. This driver bridges in-place at the call site; the adapter has NOT been migrated.

scaffold/pipeline/translators/parcel_master.py exists but is not wired into the v5.4.0 staged orchestrator for raw §4.32 ingest. The Build Mode Protocol §02.3 doc-type normalization stage 2 is effectively bypassed by this driver's in-place bridge.

§17 debtor_party_engine correctly routed all 300 parcel_master records to REVIEW_REQUIRED (owner role 'unresolved', owner_name placeholder 'PARCEL_MASTER against unidentified party'). The canonical_doc_type 'PARCEL_MASTER' is not registered in §17.C debtor_party_rules — REVIEW_REQUIRED is the correct fallback.

§19 aggregator collapsed 300 raw events to 36 matched_leads via the (parcel_id, canonical_doc_type, signal_type) aggregation key. 300 -> 36 implies heavy parcel-id duplication in the bounded sample (OBJECTID 1-300 of the live Tax Parcels layer); this is fixture noise, not a real Smith County data property.

§20 Check 4 (Enrichment status decoupling integrity) = INVALID: '36 enrichment-only row(s) with no PRIMARY_EVENT_SOURCE signal (No False Dashboard, §13.5).' This is correct framework behavior. The §13.5 'No False Dashboard' rule blocks deploy because every candidate row originates from enrichment, not from a primary event source.

§20 Check 5 (Signal aggregation integrity) = AMBIGUOUS: '36 signal(s) have count above the distinct instrument-number count — null-instrument records (legitimate §18.E) or a dedup [issue].' Parcel records have no instrument_number (§4.32 wrapped enrichment) so this is the legitimate-null-instrument branch, not a dedup bug.

§20 skipped 6 of 12 checks (3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11): parcel-resolution plausibility, OCR confidence routing, CSV output schema, source proof links, dashboard row integrity, methodology consistency. All require deploy-time artifacts not present pre-deploy (§20.H).
